The table has a minimum width of 72 rem (about 1150 px plus padding) inside a horizontally scrolling .table-wrap. The wrapper scrolls at every viewport width tested from 390 up to 2400 px (e.g. 390: 300 px visible of 1604; 1440: 1010 of 1656; 1920: 1466 of 1656) and fits only at about 2560 px. The scroll is not limited to phones. Below 1024 px the sidebar also becomes an off-canvas drawer (SCR-04), OQ-V-10
